overview.name: Capital Group Core Bond ETF
overview.description: The fund advisor seeks to maximize the investors level of current income and preserve the investors capital by investing primarily in bonds. Normally the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in bonds and other debt securities, which may be represented by derivatives such as futures contracts and swaps. The fund is non-diversified.
